{{Top|leg}}
The '''Voorlach Temple''' was an archaeological site on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Krykis IV]]. Items, believed to be religious relics, from the site toured three [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] before further evidence revealed that the temple was in fact an indoor marketplace, and the relics were common market goods.<ref name="FFCA">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref>
